high_level_description: A rainy neon-lit street in a modern Asian city at night, people with umbrellas, reflections on the wet asphalt, cinematic.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Narrow street lined with tall buildings covered in glowing signs in pink, cyan and yellow, steam rising from a vent, rain falling diagonally.

elements.desc: Woman in a long beige trench coat walking toward the camera holding a transparent umbrella, her face lit by the neon from the side.
Two cyclists in dark rain ponchos riding away from the camera on the left side of the street.
Small food stall on the right with a red awning and paper lanterns, a cook visible behind steam.
Glowing cyan neon sign above the food stall, uppercase, bold, upright, small.
Puddles on the asphalt in the foreground reflecting the signs as streaks of colour.
